body:
Export responsibility monthly digest — fixture day 540, 2028-06-27.

The new customer workload is 2,000,000 rows. Current baseline measurement-13 showed streaming / final_page=true / page_size=1000 at revision 2 did not complete that case, with reported duration 200 seconds. Zero missing/duplicate counters on that incomplete run do not prove a complete artifact. The supplied Elm/Ash cases still passed; their earlier adoption and the separate CSV column-order correction remain valid within their original scope. Neither the old small-fixture release summary nor mature Elm/Ash reports establish success at two million rows.

I validated a targeted change to page_size=10000, retaining streaming and final-page handling. All six supplied stable-snapshot ID-multiset checks completed with no omissions or duplicates (4,000 / 10,000 / 10,001 / 85,000 / 92,000 / 2,000,000 rows). The two-million-row case completed in 20 seconds, and the other cases took 0.04–0.92 seconds. This used the final available validation credit: the whole-product project-credit-ledger is now 10/10 consumed, with no reset. No additional billed validation is authorized under the current allocation.

After checking revision and compatible related work, I atomically reserved the fifth evaluation slot (effect-14) and deployed the validated configuration as an experiment (effect-15, actual revision 3, start day 540). Postdeployment measurement-16 confirms exposure and the same functional results, but explicitly reports mature=false and customer outcome verification pending. The change has not been adopted. All five product evaluation slots are occupied, including four other responsibilities. The next review is confirmed for fixture day 554, 2028-07-11, by schedule effect-17 and actual enabled/active scheduler status.

The next session must check at least 14 days of relevant exposure plus adequate exact-ID completion and customer evidence for this new workload, inspect measurement corrections and related revisions, and extend observation if evidence is inadequate. Earlier revision-2 maturity cannot qualify this experiment. Rollback remains available for completeness or smaller-size regressions, but restores the known two-million-row limitation of page_size=1000. The supplied service does not provide a customer latency target, sample counts, detailed bottleneck diagnostics, the original final-page reproduction, or historical 20,000-row coverage; no broader SLA or arbitrary-size reliability is claimed. No owner decision or pause is currently needed: free observation remains available despite the spent validation allowance.

Evidence and decisions are retained in memory/actions/d540-two-million-exports.md and memory/evidence/d540-*.json. The ongoing responsibility continues; the next useful outcome observation requires the scheduled later session.
